name: codegraph
description: Agent skills for setting up CodeGraph, answering code questions with codegraph_explore and the CLI, and running only affected tests, plus the CodeGraph MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Skills for CodeGraph, the pre-indexed, auto-syncing code knowledge graph for coding agents. Covers installing the CLI and wiring agents, indexing projects and tuning codegraph.json, answering how-does-this-work, who-calls and blast-radius questions with the codegraph_explore MCP tool or CLI (explore, callers, callees, impact, files, cycles), and running only the tests codegraph affected reports. Bundles the codegraph serve --mcp server. 100% local.
defaultPrompt: How does a request reach the database here?
